name: The Metaluna Mutant
description: A big-brained insectoid worker from a dying alien world

film.title: This Island Earth
film.note: Shot in Technicolor. Based on the novel This Island Earth by Raymond F. Jones.

legend: The 1950s swapped gothic castles for flying saucers, and audiences worried about the bomb flocked to science fiction. This Island Earth sends two scientists to Metaluna, a planet losing an interplanetary war, where they meet the Mutant: a creature bred as a worker, with an enormous exposed brain and pincer claws. It's only on screen for the final act, yet it became one of the most recognisable monsters of the decade.

myths.claim: The Mutant is on screen for most of This Island Earth.
myths.explanation: It only appears in the final act, but it's the image everyone remembers.

myths.claim: This Island Earth was filmed in colour.
myths.explanation: It was shot in Technicolor, which was still costly for science fiction in 1955.

myths.claim: The Mutant's costume covered it from head to toe.
myths.explanation: The Mutant famously wears a pair of ordinary trousers. The costume's legs were reportedly never finished.

legacy: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Movie (1996) riffed on This Island Earth
facts: The Mutant comes from Metaluna, a planet losing an interplanetary war
It was bred as a worker creature, with a huge exposed brain
The Mutant wears ordinary trousers; the costume's legs were reportedly never finished
This Island Earth was based on a novel by Raymond F. Jones
The film was riffed in Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Movie (1996)
It's one of the few Universal monsters to come from outer space
hostIntro: Tonight we leave the graveyard for outer space! Our guest has a brain the size of a beach ball and, famously, trousers.
